title: Vmake 5-second commercial reference comparison 2026-09-10
body: CONFIRMED: input, Cleaner v3 and Vmake files decode to 147 frames at 1080x1920. Vmake scene cuts occur at frames 71 and 101 versus 74 and 104 in input/Cleaner, so visual pairing requires Vmake offset -3. Aligned 144-frame comparison shows Cleaner v3 removes subtitles but leaves localized blur/texture loss and buckle deformation; Vmake preserves more visible texture and contour in this clip. Subtitle-band Laplacian variance proxy: original 31.838, Cleaner v3 14.512, Vmake 62.256; proxy can reward noise/sharpening and is not a quality score. This is one commercial-reference clip without ground truth, so it cannot establish general win rate. No GPU job was run; incremental cost USD 0.
